purpose: ELMA Wiki merges colleagues' overlapping configuration changes into a working, installable configuration.

authorization.text: Owner explicitly requested: 'I want non stop execution of the plan. and make the dashboard show actual data.' This registers continuous execution of the independently verified PLAN-01 report at issuecomment-6086757327, through the working-configuration outcome, not another planning-only campaign. Advance eligible implementation, independent verification and publication automatically; retain parent responsibility and explicit unresolved gates. Preserve the existing A/B/C/I reservations, keep human #59/#41 deferred and #19 provider execution disabled. The previous owner-authorized uncapped worker runs and Codex/Claude/Cursor priority remain. Repository changes are assigned to netbka/elma_wiki only; netbka/elma365 metadata may be inspected read-only for the native contract. No other repository mutation, merges, production operations, account/provider changes, purchasing, credential access or worktree deletion are authorized. Missing native/environment/license/Target authority is a concrete gate, not permission to redefine the product or claim completion.

constraints: Execute the accepted PLAN-01 package DAG toward Wiki #94's working-configuration outcome. Read the verified plan https://github.com/netbka/elma_wiki/issues/91#issuecomment-6086757327 and current #91 before changes. Inspect main/open PRs and active claims. Preserve A UI, B domain/store, C resolver and I serial integration ownership. Do not duplicate a currently active claimed slice; report its exact head/PR and concrete overlap blocker.

Read AGENTS.md, .agent/capabilities.yaml and current Solution-first product authority. Reuse existing reducer/store, renderer, native adapters and #11 delivery coordinator. Review acceptance is an intermediate milestone, not full working-release acceptance.

Work only in the assigned supervisor checkout. Do not remove any worktree, delete branches, touch private evidence or other checkouts. Supervisor owns push/PR/comments; workers never publish, merge or deploy. Override the generic project startup cleanup with preservation for this campaign.

Source/code changes are assigned only in netbka/elma_wiki. Read-only native contract/issue metadata in netbka/elma365#60 is permitted. Do not mutate native or other repositories, call live state-changing provider APIs, launch product daemons, select a live Target/candidate or inspect private exports.
Keep #59/#41 human work deferred and #19 provider execution disabled. Do not restart human reviews or provider execution as a way around a missing release gate.

Never open .env, credentials, secret files, customer exports, private messages or participant records. Use synthetic fixtures. Keep only secret names/references; operational credentials and customer content stay private.

Evidence is observed, verified, planned or unknown. No source or merged PR is proof of native/runtime/business acceptance. Missing serializers, ancestry, identity, receipts, licenses, bindings and recovery evidence must block eligibility. Preserve unknown/opaque bytes; never forge entitlement or remove paid flags.

Each bounded implementation requires a coherent commit, focused tests at the changed invariant, affected contracts/Storybook where relevant, and independent exact-head verification. Do not resolve by documentation alone when code is assigned. Return evidence-unavailable with concrete acquisition attempts for missing evidence; blocked-owner-reserved must cite the genuine authority/owner-action trigger. Continue all permitted work before reporting a gate.

Dependencies published as PRs are not integrated. Tasks requiring merged dependencies wait until their verified commits are ancestors of freshly fetched origin/main. Do not copy an unreviewed interface or bypass that gate. Maintain semantic/resource reservations and stale-input checks.

tasks.title: Lane A: explicit base and component-scope preparation UI
tasks.outcome: When preparing a change, analysts see its base version and exactly which components it includes.
tasks.goal: Implement PLAN-01 P1 / existing A MR-01 GO in the existing partial Change preparation flow using #95/#103 fields. Display accepted full-base choices with exact revisions, clearly distinguish declared from verified ancestry, and expose exact named captured-component membership. Preserve unknown legacy behavior, context and drafts on stale/rejected or uncertain submission. Reserve web/managed and affected same-renderer fixtures; do not edit B reducer/store or C resolver.
acceptance: Base selection and named component scope are usable in the existing Solution journey and the same production/Storybook renderer.
Historical/unknown base, duplicate/foreign members, stale concurrent submit, failed/uncertain response and draft retention have focused synthetic UI/API evidence.
Absence does not imply deletion, declared ancestry is not certified, and no unsupported deletion, automatic merge/build or native dispatch is enabled.

tasks.title: Lane B: conservative three-way component merge plan
tasks.outcome: Wiki compares the base with two colleagues' changes and lists, part by part, what agrees and what conflicts.
tasks.goal: Implement PLAN-01 P2 / existing B MR-02 GO as a deterministic helper alongside the existing reducer. Compare immutable declared base B, current accepted A and incoming partial C using exact identity/digest/base/scope/tombstone evidence. Classify unchanged, one-sided, identical concurrent, divergent, addition and delete/edit cases, preserving both contributions and unknown identity. Reserve focused domain/reducer/tests and affected managed contract, not A UI or C resolver. Do not materialize bytes or enable acceptance/build.
acceptance: Frozen output binds exact B/A/C revisions and digests and has deterministic unchanged, one-sided, identical, divergent, addition and delete/edit tests.
Partial absence stays unchanged unless an explicit validated tombstone exists. Duplicate IDs, unknown base/identity and rename uncertainty remain blocked.
Both contributions/source references and unknown bytes are retained; changed input invalidates plans and declared ancestry remains an assertion.

tasks.title: Lane C: dependency and Target-profile evidence resolver
tasks.outcome: Before release, Wiki checks every required module and paid add-on against proof it is on the target server.
tasks.goal: Implement PLAN-01 P5 / existing C MR-05 GO as a pure resolver feeding the release scope planner. Bind required dependencies and paid/opaque prerequisites to exact compatible verified preinstallation receipts or authorized intact official distribution. Match version, provenance, digest, Target/profile and environment bindings. Preserve missing native receipt semantics as unknown rather than inventing evidence. Reserve focused resolver/tests/contract; no B store or A UI changes and no provider calls or eligibility switch.
acceptance: Deterministic resolver/planner tests cover compatible/incompatible/missing receipts, profile/digest/version mismatch, revoked/expired/stale evidence, duplicate providers and missing bindings.
Readable paid bytes, catalog membership, assertion-only receipts and paid=false never establish entitlement or activation.
Output remains fail closed for absent native provenance/expiry/compatibility contracts and keeps publicationReady/executionEnabled false. Positive synthetic receipts are labelled synthetic.

tasks.title: Wiki native-unit and configuration-coverage evidence adapter
tasks.outcome: Wiki uses ELMA's own unit lists so a release includes every part an application needs.
tasks.goal: Implement the Wiki side of PLAN-01 P4 by consuming available pinned native elma365#60 unit/coverage declarations through the existing planner. Account for exact application membership/import units, digest-bound part expansion, nonempty Target preservation and global-domain completeness. Acquire native metadata read-only; missing executable native handling remains a named prerequisite for P6/P8, never a synthetic native-success claim. Do not implement in the native repository or operate an environment.
acceptance: Adapter contract and focused synthetic planner tests cover minimal supported unit, membership/part expansion, diamond/coupled cycles, unsupported members and unknown globals.
Duplicate providers and stale digest/profile evidence block; full-server completeness cannot pass with missing domain handling.
Record inspected native contract revision and exact unverified/missing receipt or coverage facts. Required native evidence stays separate from implemented Wiki accounting.

tasks.title: Durable conflict resolutions and immutable review binding
tasks.outcome: Analysts resolve each conflict with a recorded choice and reason that reviewers see unchanged.
tasks.goal: Implement PLAN-01 P3 on the integrated reviewed P2 contract in the existing reducer/store/review model. Persist actor/reason and supported resolution choices as an immutable revision referencing B/A/C. Preserve unaffected content and reject stale or competing resolutions. Expose contextual resolution through the existing renderer where supported; preserve A's integrated UI. Do not replace the engine, infer fine-grained identity or enable materialization without proof.
acceptance: Stale base/plan/resolution and two concurrent writes cannot overwrite or silently choose last upload; exact reviewed input references persist.
Restart/failed atomic write preserve committed state. Delete/edit conflict, dependent stale review and untouched content have store/API regression evidence.
Affected same-renderer UI/Storybook contracts are updated; unsupported identity/residual evidence stays blocked.

tasks.title: Contracts physical materialization via the native adapter
tasks.outcome: Wiki turns the resolved changes in the Contracts scenario into a real installable package.
tasks.goal: Implement the thin Wiki P6 materialization integration using the reviewed P3 revision, P4 units/closure, P5 profile/locks and original bytes. Reuse the versioned supported native artifact/build contract. Produce native artifacts and a bound manifest; preserve unchanged/unknown bytes, resources and source/runtime coupling. Resolve available contract evidence read-only. If the actual serializer/compiler/native adapter is unavailable, finish permitted code and return concrete evidence-unavailable; do not substitute a design report, synthetic artifact or widget-only proof for physical Contracts materialization.
acceptance: Build inputs bind resolved revision, native unit/profile/compiler/dependency locks and exact originals; changed input stales output and missing serializer/compiler/resources fails closed.
No-edit, one-edit and two-change round trips preserve unknown resources/manifests and coupled source/runtime without blanket metadata exclusions.
Exact physical outputs have supported native validation evidence at the Contracts layer. Synthetic client tests are additional evidence and cannot satisfy this criterion.

tasks.title: Composed candidate and guarded delivery integration
tasks.outcome: The merged package can go through Wiki's guarded delivery flow, tested without touching a live server.
tasks.goal: Implement PLAN-01 P7 through the existing #11 deliveryStore/coordinator using exact P6 artifacts and P4/P5 scope/order/profile/review/dependency evidence. Extend the unchanged-original route deliberately to a frozen composed candidate with trusted execution actors, Target reservations, recovery and stale-input checks. Preserve contextual/shared and legacy-root isolation. This task implements guards and synthetic integration, never live dispatch, a second coordinator or inferred native idempotency.
acceptance: Composed candidates bind exact artifacts/manifest/profile/review and preserve cross-root identity and provenance versus execution actor separation.
Focused tests cover one reservation/coordinator, async prepare/confirm/verify stale checks, deploying persistence before dispatch, cancellation before dispatch only, and truthful multi-unit receipts.
Crash/lost response/unknown outcome cannot redispatch. Synthetic store/API/renderer evidence includes security and concurrency boundaries; no live execution is claimed.

tasks.title: Exact-byte isolated Contracts acceptance gate
tasks.outcome: Proof that the Contracts package installs and works on an isolated server, or exactly what is missing.
tasks.goal: Own PLAN-01 P8 to actual isolated native/business acceptance. Acquire existing exact-candidate/profile/ancestry/dependency/license/binding/import/read-back/recovery evidence through permitted read-only metadata and prepare the concrete acceptance harness. Do not select a Target or execute a live operation without destination-specific authority. Missing native evidence returns evidence-unavailable with attempts; missing genuine environment/candidate authorization returns blocked-owner-reserved with its trigger. A readiness report alone cannot resolve this task. Preserve both changes' full parent business-route outcome.
acceptance: Frozen physical candidate and explicitly authorized isolated matching environment have actual installation/read-back evidence; no-op/mismatched/extra/missing/stale outcomes fail.

Both changes and selected conflict resolution work together with correct source/runtime/forms/permissions/resources and full affected parent outputs, including return/resubmit/cancel/error/duplicate/recovery cases.
Independent native/business evidence binds exact candidate/profile and clean/reset Target; otherwise keep task and parent blocked, never mark report publication as product acceptance.

tasks.title: Destination promotion, recovery and all-scope completion gate
tasks.outcome: Whether release to the real destination is ready, with every release scope confirmed, or exactly which gates remain.
tasks.goal: Own PLAN-01 P9 and remaining #94 application-part/application/Solution/server coverage outcome after Contracts acceptance. Reconcile actual destination-specific authorization, read-back/business/recovery evidence and supported domain coverage. Acquire available evidence read-only; do not purchase, access credentials, mutate providers, select a live destination or promote production. Record exact missing engineering versus owner gates. Return resolved only for the real assigned outcome with independent evidence, never because Contracts passed or because future scope was documented.
acceptance: Exact accepted artifact has destination-specific promotion/read-back/recovery/business evidence under that project's separately authorized release gate.

Required application-part, application, Solution and server domains/dependencies/global configuration have executable supported handling and matching native evidence; one Contracts slice does not establish universal coverage.
All unresolved implementation, native, destination and owner gates keep the parent open. #59/#41 remain deferred and #19 remains disabled absent explicit changed authority.
